reviews.decision_reason: select_demand keeps all corpus rows with demand_score >= 3 and constructs explicit demand records with the expected handoff fields. In this package, all eight supplied records meet that threshold, so the selection step itself does not explain the one-record output.

normalize truncates the selected demand DataFrame to head(1) via index_window = [0]. That drops valid selected records n06-r02 through n06-r08 before both downstream handoffs are assembled, contradicting the requirement to preserve the exact needs/evidence_sources handoffs and leaving only n06-r01 in the observed output.

assemble_provenance deterministically ranks the normalized rows by demand_score descending and record_id. The deficient one-row evidence_sources output follows from the already-truncated normalize input, not from this provenance assembly step.
